trailhead.label: The Malga Frommer Alm by the top station of the Nova Levante gondola, the board’s start

cautions: Busy around the gondola station and the Malga Frommer Alm in summer: keep your dog on a short lead.
Path 1A runs just above the Via Nigra road.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
